mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear morning with temperatures around 52 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School.

In city news, mark your calendars for trick-or-treat hours on October 31 from 5 PM to 8 PM. Also, the city is celebrating the third year of the Week Without Driving initiative to increase awareness for non-drivers.
We have a busy schedule with Hop Haus Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
In our police report, on September 21, officers identified and cited a suspect for the retail theft of candy from a local business.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by to enjoy a scoop.
